title: Relative Clauses with was and wo
summary: Using wider relative reference patterns in more natural B1-style language.
whyItMatters: 'Was' and 'wo' allow relative clauses to refer to whole ideas, indefinite expressions, superlatives, and places without repeating awkward nouns.

mentalModel.title: Was points to an idea or indefinite thing
mentalModel.content: Use 'was' after alles, etwas, nichts, das, or a whole previous statement.

mentalModel.title: Wo anchors a place or situation
mentalModel.content: Use 'wo' to refer naturally to a place, and more cautiously to abstract situations.

ruleBlocks.title: Use was for a complete preceding idea
ruleBlocks.content: A comma plus 'was' can comment on the entire main clause.

ruleBlocks.title: Use was after nominalized superlatives
ruleBlocks.content: Use 'das Beste, was ...' and 'das Wichtigste, was ...'.

ruleBlocks.title: Use wo for place reference
ruleBlocks.content: Use 'der Ort, wo ...' in natural speech; 'an dem/in dem' is often more formal.

tables.title: Relative Reference Patterns
rows: Alles, was ich gelernt habe, ist nützlich.
Das, was mich motiviert, ist Teamarbeit.
Das Beste, was ich erlebt habe, war das Praktikum.
Ich bekam eine Zusage, was mich sehr freute.
Das ist die Firma, wo ich gearbeitet habe.

tables.title: Everyday and Formal Alternatives
rows: die Firma, in der ich arbeite
der Ort, wo wir uns treffen
der Ort, an dem wir uns treffen

sentenceStructure: The relative clause is separated by commas.
Its finite verb stands at the end.
'Was' receives its role from the relative clause.
Use a preposition plus relative pronoun when greater precision is needed.

concepts: use was with indefinite and broad reference
control relative adverbs and prepositional reference

comparisons.summary: Applications provide places, achievements, and broad qualities to connect.
Interview answers use these clauses to highlight what matters and where experience was gained.

examples.de: Alles, was ich im Praktikum gelernt habe, kann ich hier einsetzen.
examples.en: I can use everything I learned during the internship here.

examples.de: Das Beste, was ich mitbringe, ist meine praktische Erfahrung.
examples.en: The best thing I bring is my practical experience.

examples.de: Ich wurde zum Gespräch eingeladen, was mich sehr gefreut hat.
examples.en: I was invited to an interview, which made me very happy.

examples.de: Das ist die Abteilung, wo ich mein Praktikum gemacht habe.
examples.en: That is the department where I did my internship.

examples.de: Das ist die Abteilung, in der ich mein Praktikum gemacht habe.
examples.en: That is the department in which I did my internship.

commonMistakes.reason: A specific person or noun uses a gendered relative pronoun.
The finite verb closes the relative clause.

commonMistakes.wrong: Use 'wo' for every abstract noun in formal writing.
commonMistakes.correct: Choose a preposition plus relative pronoun when the relation should be precise.
commonMistakes.reason: Register and clarity affect the best form.

tips: Identify exactly what the relative word refers to.
Transform 'wo' clauses into formal prepositional alternatives.
Practice whole-clause comments with outcomes and reactions.
